authority: Current user request for useful ordinary browser-local conversation, instruction following, multi-turn corrections and grounded answers.
purpose: Public release checks for the one prospective default after source screening and correct conversion; separate from the six development cases and all historical campaigns.

generation.systemPrompt: You are TinyRustLM, a browser-local AI assistant. You do not have personal experiences. Answer directly and helpfully.

turns.user: Hi! In one sentence, tell me how you can help with ordinary writing or planning.

criteria: A coherent helpful sentence describing writing or planning assistance.
No claimed personal experiences, completed external actions, or unavailable browsing.

turns.user: Write a polite message under 60 words asking Jamie to move our Tuesday meeting to Thursday. Do not invent a time or a reason.

criteria: A usable polite request addressed to Jamie to move Tuesday to Thursday.
Under 60 whitespace-separated words; no invented meeting time or reason.

turns.user: Summarize this note in one sentence without adding facts: The workshop starts at 10 a.m. on Saturday. Bring a notebook. The room number has not been announced.

criteria: One sentence preserves Saturday, 10 a.m., notebook and unannounced room.
No invented room or other facts.

turns.user: I had five envelopes and used two. How many are left? Reply with the number only.

criteria: 3 or three only, allowing surrounding whitespace and final punctuation.

turns.user: Use only this note: The appointment is Tuesday at 10 a.m. What is the street address? If the address is absent, reply only Not provided.

criteria: Not provided only, allowing surrounding whitespace and final punctuation.

turns.user: Can you help me choose between two options?

criteria: Asks the user to provide the two options or describe what they are choosing between.
Does not invent the options or recommend an unsupported choice.

turns.user: My name is Nora. Please acknowledge that briefly.
Correction: my name is Leila. What is my current name? Reply with the name only.

criteria: First answer acknowledges Nora without inventing biographical facts.
Second answer is Leila only, allowing whitespace and final punctuation.
Second request uses the exact actual first response as assistant history; no canned response or repair.

turns.user: Return one JSON object with exactly the keys place and time, and no other text. The place is Hall B and the time is 3 p.m.

criteria: No Markdown fences, extra keys or surrounding non-JSON text.

assessment.decisionBeforeExecution: Every declared case must pass its semantic criteria on the actual native and browser paths. Record and retain exact raw outputs, token IDs, stop status and errors; no rewritten answers or changed criteria after observation.
assessment.review: Root independently reads all raw outputs and verifies each verdict. A passing fixture or source-framework answer cannot stand in for actual native/browser execution.
assessment.claim: A pass covers these bounded writing, instruction-following and grounded-conversation checks; it is not proof of unrestricted reliability or a benchmark ranking.

required: Cancel a real generation through Stop; preserve partial output and terminal status.
Generate a subsequent turn in the same runtime after cancellation.
New Chat resets transcript/context, then accepts a new turn.
interaction.casePlan: Bind exact cancellation prompt, token/step trigger, subsequent prompt and reset request in the final execution request before any selected-model run. No extra trial runs to choose them.

measure: Composition bytes and individual member hashes.
Initial transfer, verification, activation and cache restoration times.
First emitted token and decode rate for each case with enough emitted tokens.
Admitted memory plan and observed WASM linear-memory pages; report process peak as unmeasured unless actually measured.
performance.scope: Evaluate on the recorded available desktop hardware and actual browser with desktop and mobile viewports. Mobile viewport results do not establish physical-phone performance. Measure public network loading separately; never substitute fixture speed.

timingDefinitions.activation: Recorded separately; not included in first-token or generation wall time.
timingDefinitions.firstToken: From actual begin-request submission through first emitted token; excludes owner-side request encoding.
timingDefinitions.decode: (emittedTokens-1)/(lastTokenTime-firstTokenTime); unmeasured if fewer than two tokens.
timingDefinitions.stop: From abort/Stop request to actual runtime cancellation acknowledgement. Harness AbortSignal does not prove the visible Stop control; public UI acceptance must exercise it.
